reviews.text: The staff are amazing! My dog is very nervous but they did an amazing job. Thank you so much ladies. Would definitely recommend.
They always do a good job

The 2 lady's that work here are amazing and caring not just with the dogs  but with your customers. They was so good with my dog for nail trimming as my dog was a nervous dog and they was amazing with her will use again
brought my dog to streetly dog grooming for the first time really pleased how friendly the staff were and my dog looked amazing and rebooked to come back in 6 weeks and i would recommend highly.

I have had an awful experience with Streetly dog grooming. My dog had been going for over a year the manager is extremely rude but for convenience we kept going. The last time my dog came back and his dew claw was severely bleeding. They had attempted to cut his claws and cut it right down causing my dog to be in excruciating pain. I had to take him to the vets to get it removed. I phoned the manager about this is she was very rude arguing with me in a very aggressive manner. I do not recommend unless you want your dog traumatised. I wish I would of stopped going ages ago never again

I called Streetly Dog Grooming in desperation for our dog we had adopted the weekend prior. He was badly matted round his rear end and desperately needed a groom. Thankfully, the lovely owner fitted me in on the same day, and was so helpful. She advised that he would need a very low cut to start out again.

I could not thank Streetly Dog Grooming enough! I took a very unhappy, unkept dog in and collected a very happy trimmed doggy.

Thank you!
the staff was lovely and did exactly what I had asked to be done  and made sure I was happy with the result.i am very pleased and will be going here again.

We love Jo & the team at Streetly Dog Grooming, they’ve been grooming Ozzy for years, he’s excited to go there!  Ozzy is a large cockapoo with thick curly hair & Jo pays great attention to ensuring he’s well groomed & looked after . . . in fact she spotted a problem after our vet missed it!  Highly recommend them. Xx

My boy went to Joanne many times before he passed away . Now my new boy attends when we come over on holidays .loads of experience with big dogs and it's like your dog is a part of their family.Highly recommended wouldn't go anywhere else in UK.

Been coming here since my dog was a puppy and Jo and the team always do a lovely job on my dog.
Always friendly and helpful.

Just got our dog Bella from streetly dog groomers she looks lovely ,lovely and friendly staff been going for about 18months now can't fault  them ,I never worry when I take her there and Bella ok with it aswell  .
Took my dog for the first time for a puppy groom all the staff were lovely really pleased with my groom will be returning
My boys look lovely super place and girls

Absolutely amazing .... the owner, jo, is truly exceptional and was so kind and careful with my dog Harvey today. She  went above and beyond, and I'm so very grateful to her  ..sue was also  brilliant ... iv now found a place. I'm totally happy and won't be ever going anywhere else ....

Once again thank you Joanne and her amazing staff at Streetly Dog Groomers for a fantastic service. My three Pomeranians came out looking gorgeous again today like they have since 2017. Look forward to seeing you all again in a few months time.

I brought my beautiful fluffy pom here for a small tidy to which I specifically asked them to NOT cut him just to shape his paws etc. When I picked my dog up he was shaking and very scared even though he is the most confident and happy dog, he had also been completely shaved (which wasn’t even done evenly). My dog was sick the entire journey home and when I reached out to talk to them about it they would not answer the phone. I took to instagram to share my experience where many people reached out to tell me horror story’s about this place, I have contacted the rspca as this place and the cruel people working at it are a danger to dogs! I have attached pictures of how my dog looked before and how he looked after being butchered by this groomer.

Please do not take your dogs here!! We have taken our Pom here today and he has come back trebling and physically sick, the picture was taken moments after. My dog is very lively and since he has come back he has hid in the corner of the room. Not to mention I advised the staff that he cannot have his fur shaved as he is double coated, all educated groomers would know this, however I was completely ignored and they have shaved him short!! Pomeranian owners will know that this is dangerous for the dog as it could affect them regulating their temperature.

The worst groomers I have ever come across. AVOID. They made our dog violently sick, shaved him when his breed shouldn’t be shaved & he hasn’t stop shaking since coming back. They have avoided all our calls and when raising awareness on …

Lovely staff .

Called to see if they was happy to take a look at my super friendly in training …
